columns.comment: Note id = the CRM activity id (ACT-nnnnnnn) the note was written on.
columns.name: note_id

columns.comment: Date of the RM activity (meeting / call / e-mail / visit) the note records - the grain date.
columns.name: note_date

columns.comment: First day of the calendar month of the note.
columns.name: month

columns.comment: Surrogate key of the dim_client version valid on this row's date (SCD2 as-was join, D11); join to gold.dim_client.golden_client_sk for the client attributes at that time.
columns.name: golden_client_sk

columns.comment: Durable golden client id from entity resolution (GC-nnnnnn), stable across ER runs and SCD2 versions; one golden client = one resolved legal entity.
columns.name: golden_client_id

columns.comment: Client group (global parent group) id from the Tokyo HO group master (SYN-G-nnnn); join to gold.dim_client_group.
columns.name: client_group_id

columns.comment: CRM account id (source record of the CRM platform) the row was recorded against.
columns.name: crm_account_id

columns.comment: CRM code (RM001-RM120) of the RM who wrote the note.
columns.name: rm_code

columns.comment: Employee id of the RM who wrote the note; join gold.dim_employee for name and office.
columns.name: employee_id

columns.comment: Client contact met (CRM contact id); join gold.dim_contact.
columns.name: contact_id

columns.comment: Activity type: Meeting, Call, Video Call, Email or Site Visit.
columns.name: activity_type

columns.comment: Purpose of the activity: Signal Follow-up, Deal Progress, Relationship Review, Product Discussion, Service Review, Market Update, Account Planning, Courtesy Visit or Credit Review.
columns.name: purpose

columns.comment: Activity subject line as recorded in CRM.
columns.name: subject

columns.comment: Product discussed, e.g. Cash Pooling, FX Forward Programme (null when none).
columns.name: product_discussed

columns.comment: Product family: Corporate Lending, Structured Lending, Cash, Liquidity, Payments, Trade Finance, Supply Chain Finance, FX, Rates or Sustainable Finance.
columns.name: product_family

columns.comment: Synthetic RM note text (at most 40 words; fictional entities only).
columns.name: note_text

columns.comment: Tone tag the CRM stored with the note: Positive, Neutral or Negative.
columns.name: raw_tone

columns.comment: Note sentiment score -1 (very negative) .. +1 (very positive): template tone plus noise, deterministic (D18). Average it, never sum.
columns.name: sentiment_score

columns.comment: Label from the score: Negative (<= -0.2), Positive (>= 0.2) or Neutral - the label used by the flags and signals.
columns.name: sentiment_label

columns.comment: Label returned by Databricks ai_analyze_sentiment(note_text) at build time: Positive, Negative, Neutral or Mixed (null if the function returned none). Stored alongside the score (D18 / D36); not used for storyline numbers.
columns.name: ai_sentiment_label

columns.comment: Where ai_sentiment_label came from: ai_analyze_sentiment, or not returned (the function gave no label for this note).
columns.name: ai_label_source

columns.comment: True when the AI label equals the score label (Mixed never agrees); null when no AI label - use for the AI vs synthetic agreement rate.
columns.name: ai_agrees_with_score

columns.comment: True when the note sentiment score is <= -0.2.
columns.name: is_negative

columns.comment: True when the note sentiment score is >= 0.2.
columns.name: is_positive

columns.comment: Primary topic extracted from the note text by keyword rules (first match): Credit & Liquidity, Pricing, Competition, Service Quality, Market & FX, Relationship, New Business, else General.
columns.name: note_topic

columns.comment: All topics extracted from the note text, comma-separated in the same order (e.g. Competition, New Business).
columns.name: topics_text

columns.comment: True when the note records a follow-up action for the RM.
columns.name: action_required

columns.comment: Follow-up action agreed, e.g. Send indicative term sheet (null when none).
columns.name: next_action

columns.comment: Due date of the follow-up action.
columns.name: next_action_due_date

columns.comment: Status of the follow-up action at the as-of date: Completed, Open or Overdue (null when no action).
columns.name: next_action_status

columns.comment: True when the follow-up action is still Open or Overdue at 30-Sep-2026 (Actions Open).
columns.name: is_action_open

columns.comment: True when the follow-up action is Overdue at 30-Sep-2026.
columns.name: is_action_overdue

columns.comment: CRM opportunity signal the activity followed up (fact_signal_event.signal_event_id), when any.
columns.name: related_signal_id

columns.comment: Pipeline opportunity the activity relates to (CRM opportunity id), when any.
columns.name: related_opportunity_id

columns.comment: Duration of the activity in minutes.
columns.name: duration_minutes

columns.comment: Days between the note date and the as-of date 30-Sep-2026; last N days = days_before_as_of < N.
columns.name: days_before_as_of

columns.comment: True for notes dated in the 90 days to 30-Sep-2026 (3-Jul-2026 .. 30-Sep-2026).
columns.name: is_last_90d

columns.comment: External context: average sentiment of the client group's news in the 90 days up to the note date (null = no news).
columns.name: group_news_sentiment_90d

columns.comment: News items on the client group in the 90 days up to the note date.
columns.name: group_news_items_90d

columns.comment: Internal minus external sentiment = note sentiment - group news sentiment of the 90 days to the note (positive = the RM is more upbeat than the news); null when no news. Average it.
columns.name: sentiment_divergence

columns.comment: True when the note is Positive (>= 0.2) while the group's news sentiment over the 90 days to the note is Negative (<= -0.2).
columns.name: is_blind_spot_note

columns.comment: Group attribute as of 30-Sep-2026 (same on every row of the group): average news sentiment of the group in the last 90 days (3-Jul .. 30-Sep-2026).
columns.name: group_news_sentiment_last_90d

columns.comment: Group attribute as of 30-Sep-2026: average news sentiment of the group in the prior 90 days (4-Apr .. 2-Jul-2026).
columns.name: group_news_sentiment_prior_90d

columns.comment: Group attribute as of 30-Sep-2026: average RM-note sentiment of the group in the last 90 days.
columns.name: group_note_sentiment_last_90d

columns.comment: Blind spot as of 30-Sep-2026: the group's external sentiment turned negative (last-90-day news average <= -0.2 and the prior 90 days not <= -0.2) while its RM notes stayed positive (last-90-day note average >= 0.2). Same on every row of the group; count distinct groups.
columns.name: is_blind_spot_group

comment: Internal qualitative signal: every RM call note (CRM activity note text, synthetic, at most 40 words) with its sentiment score -1..1 (synthetic, D18), the score label (Negative <= -0.2, Positive >= 0.2), the ai_analyze_sentiment label stored alongside (D36) and their agreement, keyword-extracted topics, the follow-up action status, and the client group's external news sentiment around the note - for the internal-vs-external divergence and blind-spot questions. Flow fact: count notes, average the sentiment (never sum it). Grain: one row per RM call note (CRM activity).
